goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: User-facing claim: all four cues are trustworthy canvas-first operations with durable editor/CLI parity and native deterministic CSS. T009 fixes intermediate Drag authoring/preservation, real keyboard and responsive checks, and per-boundary semantic assertions. Additive Hold selection is mechanically fixed but semantically false: the proof selects an unanimated text element alongside the animated target; projectCueReplacement accepts the mixed scope, and expansion generates no held track for the text element. The cue silently claims a target it does not affect, violating fail-closed semantics and masking the exact residual the proof intended to close. Earlier geometry, playback metadata, Type, reduced-motion, diagnostics, history, determinism, privacy, and phase-containment evidence remains green.
evidence: T008 Drag residual — PASS: apps/editor/src/main.ts:1285-1297 creates a default interior waypoint and preserves/rescales all existing interior points. Installed Chrome creates three points, drags waypoint 1, verifies its coordinate changes, reloads, accepts a three-point CLI update, edits the cue, and proves exact waypoint preservation through undo/redo at apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:97-167.

T008 keyboard/responsive residual — PASS: installed Chrome uses actual Home and ArrowDown key events on the focused native select at apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:85-91. Narrow and wide viewport checks assert visibility and no horizontal overflow at lines 92-96 and 115.

T008 boundary residual — PASS: packages/visual-proof/src/reusable-cues.visual.test.ts:89-105 now asserts expected before/exact/after behavior for every Type step plus Select choose/settle, Drag press/move/arrive/release, and Hold enter/exit. The sanitized receipt reports 29 samples, 30 expected assertions, two identical raster runs, 19 distinct rasters, and zero repeated pixel drift.

T008 additive Hold residual — FAIL: apps/editor/src/main.ts:1551-1556 now accumulates multiple selected options, but the proof chooses ids.hold and ids.type at apps/editor/tests/phase4-reusable-cues.spec.ts:70-74. fixtures/public-synthetic/reusable-cues.html gives .hold an animation and .type no animation.

Domain counterexample — packages/domain/src/index.ts:1022-1043 accepts Hold when at least one selected target has a track; it never requires every targetId to contribute a replacement track. packages/domain/src/cue-authoring.ts:390-409 iterates only replacement tracks and checks track-to-target membership, not target-to-track coverage. Thus the resulting cue retains both target snapshots while generating Hold motion only for .hold; .type is silently ignored.

This is not cosmetic proof weakness: the UI promises “Choose animated motion,” yet its Hold options include every element through reusableTargetOptions, and shared CLI/domain preparation accepts the same mixed animated/unanimated scope. Unsupported target semantics therefore do not fail visibly.

Previously accepted evidence did not regress: installed-Chrome browser workflow passed 1/1 and visual proof passed 1/1; focused domain/protocol/CLI suites passed 30/30; native CSSAnimation inventory remains positive before reduced motion; reducedAnimationCount=0; runtime, console, HTTP, failed-request, and unexpected-network counts remain zero.

Determinism/privacy/containment remain sound: T009 recorded byte-identical installed-Chrome receipts across two runs; independent sensitive scan passed with findingCount=0 across tracked/diff/index/worktree/untracked; private-ignore passed with targetCount=3, ignoredCount=3, trackedPrivateCount=0; protected-file diff and git diff --check passed; no Slice 3 or Phase 5 work appears.

Failure mode 1, cue metadata/track drift or editor/CLI divergence — FAIL: a Hold semantic and its target snapshots can name an unanimated target absent from generated tracks. Intermediate Drag and history parity now pass.

Failure mode 2, hidden canvas gaps or incorrect browser boundaries — FAIL only for misleading Hold eligibility/effect; Drag canvas, genuine keyboard interaction, responsive containment, compiler-native preview, and per-boundary state proof pass.

Failure mode 3, leakage or green tests masking runtime failures — privacy, deterministic receipts, diagnostics, reduced motion, and phase containment PASS, but the current green browser test itself masks the mixed-scope Hold semantic defect.

parallel_safety.reason: The correction must align domain eligibility, editor target projection, the synthetic fixture, CLI rejection behavior, and installed-Chrome proof. Splitting writers risks another test that demonstrates selection without demonstrating effect.

missing_evidence: A multi-target Hold where every selected stable element has eligible animated tracks and every selected target appears in the generated Hold track inventory.
Atomic fail-closed rejection, with unchanged revision, when any Hold target is unanimated or lacks the explicit enter boundary.
Editor Hold target projection that exposes only eligible animated motion or clearly rejects an ineligible canvas choice.
required_board_updates: Insert one corrective Worker before T005. Objective: make Hold target coverage exact and fail closed, expose only eligible Hold canvas targets, and replace the false multi-target proof with two genuinely animated targets.

Corrective verify: add a second independent animated synthetic target with an explicit enter boundary; select both on canvas; assert semantic target IDs and generated Hold track element IDs cover both exactly after durable reload; reject animated-plus-unanimated and missing-boundary scopes atomically through domain and CLI with unchanged revision; verify the editor does not advertise ineligible Hold targets; rerun installed Chrome twice for byte-identical receipts, focused suites, sensitive/private scans, protected-file diff, and git diff --check.

Corrective stop_if: exact Hold coverage requires changing protocol shape, compiler/runtime interpretation, legacy cue bytes, private material, later-phase scope, or a file outside the corrective allowlist.
After correction, rerun the Judge gate before activating T005.
